what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Download the UpRock app Get the app for your device: Android , iPhone , macOS , Windows or Linux .
2 Step 2 : Create your account Sign up through the UpRock launch page .
3 Step 3 : Claim your daily rewards Watch up to three short clips each day to raise your earn rate and collect bonus UPT.
4 Step 4 : Add games, surveys and receipt scans Play featured games, answer short surveys and photograph receipts from purchases you already make. Each one earns UPT.
5 Step 5 : Invite friends Share UpRock with friends to earn a share of what they make for as long as they keep earning.
6 Step 6 : Stake your UPT if you choose Lock earned UPT for a duration you pick to earn more, and withdraw whenever you are ready.
